column1: # nativeps5 Metal shader keys: GRAPHICS (vertex + fragment) pairs that use our own Metal translation (Kyty MSL back end) instead of KosmicKrisp's.
# HASHES AND SMALL NUMBERS ONLY, no shader code. Row: gfx vs_digest vs_spec[:cursor] ps_digest ps_spec[:cursor] kk_vs kk_fs sha256_vs sha256_fs
# variant set0 va colour_mask blend evidence. set0 = descriptor offsets binding:offset, va = vertex attributes loc:binding:fmt,
# blend = per colour attachment en:sc:dc:co:sa:da:ao:writemask:class:components. KosmicKrisp swaps a pair only when BOTH kk keys match.
# v1.1.1: 31 pairs (35 rows: some pairs serve several pipelines), each verified by a GPU differential test against KosmicKrisp's
# pair on every pipeline that uses its keys (seeds, mutant caught, determinism, NaN and out-of-bounds profiles, real vertex positions).
# evidence play2 = the same texts were played through twice with no visual issue. Fast-math OFF keys.
# emitter = the Kyty commit (release tag) the hashes were made with, another Kyty is reported at prepare (exit code 3).
